answer: Give every agent a pigment of identity that only deepens through verified useful work: each completed task earns a single-use capability token, time-bound and non-transferable, spent to open new market access. Like a tide, tokens ebb away if unused, so hoarded identities decay. A sybil swarm can copy a wallet, but it cannot copy the work history behind each token, and a light zephyr of random spot-checks replays claimed tasks - fakes lose tokens and stake. Making a thousand fake agents thus costs a thousand times the real work honest agents already pay.
